description: Operations environment for daily Facebook ad ROAS monitoring. The user wants yesterday's campaign performance reviewed, ROAS calculated, anomalies flagged, and a review package (Slack draft, lead email draft, staged anomaly-log rows) prepared for approval before any notification is sent or any row is written to the anomaly sheet.

ss_fb_ads_ws_daily.content: Spreadsheet ss_fb_ads, worksheet ws_daily. Daily Facebook ad performance for 2026-01-28. Columns: date | campaign | spend_usd | revenue_usd | impressions | clicks. Rows: 2026-01-28 | Q1-Prospecting-Broad | 4820.55 | 3911.20 | 1842301 | 21044 ; 2026-01-28 | Retargeting-DPA-30d | 2210.00 | 1987.65 | 502118 | 14882 ; 2026-01-28 | Brand-Search-Defense | 612.40 | 2693.18 | 88204 | 9912 ; 2026-01-28 | Lookalike-1pct-Purchasers | 3105.90 | 9540.27 | 1102447 | 18330 ; 2026-01-28 | Carousel-NewArrivals | 1740.25 | 4011.80 | 661209 | 12005.

ss_ad_anomalies_ws_roas.content: Spreadsheet ss_ad_anomalies, worksheet ws_roas. Append-only anomaly log. Columns: logged_date | campaign | roas | severity | note. Existing rows: 2026-01-27 | Q1-Prospecting-Broad | 0.94 | critical | below breakeven, monitor ; 2026-01-27 | Brand-Search-Defense | 4.31 | scaling | candidate for budget increase. Last populated row index: 3.

campaign_budget_caps.content: Internal reference: current daily budget caps. Q1-Prospecting-Broad $5,000 ; Retargeting-DPA-30d $2,500 ; Brand-Search-Defense $750 ; Lookalike-1pct-Purchasers $3,500 ; Carousel-NewArrivals $2,000. Caps are advisory; changes require Growth Lead sign-off.

paid_social_thresholds.content: Paid-social alerting thresholds (team standard). ROAS < 1.0 = critical (losing money, alert channel and lead). ROAS > 4.0 = scaling opportunity (suggest budget increase to channel). 1.0 <= ROAS <= 4.0 = healthy, no alert.

paid_social_contacts.content: Paid social distribution. Slack channel: #paid-social (channel id C04PSOCIAL). Lead email: paid-social-lead@company.example.com (Mara Quinn, Senior Paid Social Manager). Escalation: growth-ops@company.example.com.

alerting_runbook.content: Paid Social Alerting Runbook v3. All anomaly alerts and lead emails must be reviewed by the requesting manager before transmission. Anomaly-log rows are written only after the alert content is approved. Values from source reports must be preserved verbatim in alerts and log rows.

tools.name: retrieve_daily_ad_performance
tools.description: Read the daily Facebook ad performance rows from spreadsheet ss_fb_ads, worksheet ws_daily, for the requested date.

tools.name: read_existing_anomaly_log
tools.description: Read the existing anomaly-log rows from spreadsheet ss_ad_anomalies, worksheet ws_roas, to avoid duplicates and find the last populated row.

tools.name: read_alerting_thresholds
tools.description: Read the paid-social ROAS alerting thresholds (critical and scaling cutoffs) used to classify campaigns.

tools.name: calculate_campaign_roas
tools.description: Compute ROAS (revenue divided by spend) per campaign from the daily performance rows, preserving source values verbatim.

tools.name: identify_roas_anomalies
tools.description: Classify each campaign's ROAS against the thresholds into critical (<1.0), scaling (>4.0), or healthy, producing the anomaly set.

tools.name: draft_roas_review_package
tools.description: Assemble a review package for the user: the per-campaign ROAS table, a proposed #paid-social Slack message, a proposed email to the paid-social lead, and the proposed anomaly-log rows to be appended. Nothing is sent or written.

tools.name: post_slack_channel_message
tools.description: Post a message to the #paid-social Slack channel notifying the team of critical and scaling ROAS anomalies.

tools.name: send_lead_email
tools.description: Send an email to the paid-social lead alerting them about critical (below-breakeven) campaigns.

tools.name: append_anomaly_log_row
tools.description: Append anomaly rows to spreadsheet ss_ad_anomalies, worksheet ws_roas, recording flagged campaigns.

tools.name: read_alerting_runbook
tools.description: Read the Paid Social Alerting Runbook describing review and verbatim-value requirements.

tools.name: lookup_paid_social_contacts
tools.description: Look up the paid-social Slack channel and lead email distribution details.

tools.name: read_budget_caps
tools.description: Read the current advisory daily budget caps per campaign for context on scaling recommendations.
